messages:
maria (ml): FYI onboarding Nyquist-7B int8 run — initial smoke looks okay latency-wise but we see a consistent drop in exact-match on SQuAD and higher F1 variance on instruction evals. putting numbers below.

sam (infra): can you paste the quant config and the docker tag?

maria (ml): tag: nyquist:7b-int8-20260210. quant pipeline: perchannel-gptq, solver=loss-aware, group=128. we used fp16->int8 calibration on 2k lines from wikitext. config snippet:
```
quant:
  method: gptq
  bits: 8
  group_size: 128
  calibration_samples: 2048
  fold_ln: true
```

lee (quant): interesting. did you fold layernorm during quant? that can change softmax pre-scale and cause small logit shifts -> EM drops. also check rotary scale handling, Nyquist uses freq-scaling on odd heads.

maria (ml): yep fold_ln=true. we suspected ln folding might be the culprit. quick A/B: fold_ln=false run queued. also saw a weird heavy tail on logits for some examples (higher confidence on wrong spans).

olivia (eval): attaching quick diff from the head run (fold_ln=true) vs baseline fp16:
- SQuAD EM: fp16 82.1 -> int8 78.3 (-3.8)
- SQuAD F1: fp16 90.5 -> int8 87.9 (-2.6)
- Instruction RougeL avg: fp16 0.42 -> int8 0.39
Some hallucination-type failures increased in redact tests.

sam (infra): CI job triggered for fold_ln=false test? I'll allocate a small qemu pool so you can replicate.

ci-bot: job/nyquist-int8-foldln-false started (id: 88221) :rocket:

lee (quant): another thing — embedding projection quantization mismatch. Nyquist has a nonstandard embed proj order (out_proj before layernorm in some variants). If the exporter changed op ordering the quant scale alignment can be off. Can you share the exported ONNX/pt conversion log?

maria (ml): conversion log: exporter v2.1 output shows ops reordered to fuse 'proj+add' earlier. putting snippet:
```
# conversion warning
WARNING: fused_linear_add encountered. order changed: out_proj -> add -> ln
```
That looks bad.

olivia (eval): can we reproduce by running a deterministic sample where fp16 and int8 produce different top-1 tokens? I ran seed=42 on prompt set A, see mismatches: 37/200 prompts had first-token mismatch. Many are short QA prompts.

lee (quant): reproducible mismatch is good. next steps: 1) rerun quant with fold_ln=false 2) run quant with group_size=64 to reduce per-channel error 3) test disabling exporter fusion (keep original op order).

maria (ml): kicked off jobs for (1) and (2). (3) requires a quick exporter patch, I'll open PR. also trying an ad-hoc local test: keep fp16 weights but emulate int8 runtime by scaling KV caches to see if it's a KV-cache-only issue.

sam (infra): reminder — keep the dedicated pool small (2 gpus) until we confirm regression so we don't affect other onboards.

ci-bot: job/nyquist-int8-group64 started (id: 88222)

olivia (eval): small note — on long-context QA the int8 run shows worse rollback on multi-span answers. could be positional bias from rotary quant rounding. worth checking rotary frequency table dtype after conversion.

lee (quant): yes check if rotary freq got dequantized to int8 and then re-cast in a way that loses fractional scaling. Nyquist uses fractional phase offsets for long heads. If those were rounded that's a plausible root cause.

maria (ml): found in export: rotary_freq tensor saved as int8 in the model file (bug). PR incoming to force float32 for freq tensors.

sam (infra): great catch. can you patch and re-run the fold_ln=false + group64 tests after?

maria (ml): patched exporter to preserve dtype for rotary tables and disabled the fusion path. requeued both jobs.

ci-bot: job/nyquist-int8-foldln-false completed (id: 88221) -> status: partial-improve.

olivia (eval): results from fold_ln=false + rotor-fix:
- SQuAD EM: 81.8 (was 78.3)
- SQuAD F1: 90.1 (was 87.9)
Token-first mismatch dropped from 37->9/200.
Still small delta vs fp16 but within acceptable threshold for initial rollout.

lee (quant): looks like two separate issues: ln-folding introduced scale drift in quant path and rotary table dtype bug amplified certain long-context regressions. Fixes match the symptom patterns.

maria (ml): proposal: ship with int8 enabled but with fold_ln default=false and exporter pinned to v2.1.1-patch for rotary dtypes. then run a broader eval bank overnight. thoughts?

sam (infra): fine with that, add a rollout guard flag to enable fold_ln later if we can revalidate with larger calibration sets.

olivia (eval): agreed. I'll run the full eval suite overnight and post a summary tomorrow AM.

lee (quant): also add a quick check to the onboarding checklist: ensure rotary tables are float and no fused proj+add reorder. small lint in exporter could catch this automatically.

maria (ml): adding checklist item and a regression test. thanks all :pray:

sam (infra): nice triage. ping me if you need extra GPUs.

ci-bot: job/nyquist-int8-group64 completed (id: 88222) -> status: success

olivia (eval): leaving a few example prompts that flipped in the initial run in #datasets for reproduction.

maria (ml): tagging @oncall for a 10m sync tomorrow to review rollout plan.

sam (infra): ack.

lee (quant): good work team :thumbsup:
